technology_name: DOUBLE SWITCHING CAPACITOR NETWORK (DSCN)-BASED DC-DC CONVERTER FOR CHARGING ON-BOARD ELECTRIC VEHICLE AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: High-power EV battery charging subsystems struggle with extreme voltage step-up requirements, low power transmission efficiencies, and severe weight limitations.
description: The architectural design of an ultra-compact DC-DC converter operating via an integrated Double Switching Capacitor Network (DSCN) setup that drives high power-conversion metrics while minimizing the absolute spatial layout requirements of active switches and inductors.
applications: High-voltage EV powertrain links, rapid public car charging infrastructure, airborne drone power distribution systems, and industrial micro-grid regulation arrays.
